messages:
eli: Observed CP 504s during a customer bulk-onboard. looks tied to many concurrent /handshake calls. who has context?

sara: yep, saw the spike. attach_attempts spiked x7; handshake latency p99 ~3.8s.

michael: agents retry too aggressively after certrotate. no jitter and token introspection costs CP.

jen: short-term mitigation: throttle onboarding job and enable agent-side randomized exponential backoff (base 150ms, max 4s, max_attempts 7). also add tiny in-memory tenant token cache TTL 10s.

eli: token cache sounds risky for revokes. need immediate invalidation path.

carmen: propose tenant.invalidate pubsub topic and a lightweight agent endpoint to accept invalidation pushes. on rotate, CP publishes invalidate for tenant.

infra-bot: reference handshake contract: POST /handshake with Authorization: Bearer <token> and X-Tenant-ID header. body: { agent_id, version }

sara: telemetry: counters attach_attempts, attach_failures{reason}, gauges active_handshakes, histogram handshake_latency_ms with buckets [50,100,250,500,1000,3000]. sample full traces at 1% and 100% for failures >500ms.

michael: fallback policy: after configurable failures mark endpoint degraded and route to regional-relay unless tenant opts out. console shows degraded badge.

jen: log line format suggestion: single-line JSON: {"ts":"<iso>","event":"handshake_fail","tenant":"t-12","agent":"a-9","err":"sig_mismatch","attempt":3,"backoff_ms":800} (stringified).

sara: add invalidate log: {"ts":"...","event":"invalidate_cache","tenant":"t-12","reason":"key_rotate"}. dashboards should track invalidate rate.

michael: test plan: spin up synthetic agent harness to simulate 8k concurrent attaches and cert rotations to validate backoff, invalidation delivery, and fallback tagging.

carmen: ops playbook: if invalidation delivery fails, run key-rotate checklist and consider pausing onboard jobs. include steps to quarantine tenants if abuse suspected.

eli: owners: sara -> telemetry + dashboard, jen -> backoff library + agent patch, michael -> fallback flow + console flag, carmen -> invalidate pubsub + runbook. i'll open RFC follow-up PR updating handshake contract and metric/log names.

infra-bot: CI: RFC branch passes static checks.

eli: thanks everyone. will schedule short sync after RFC lands. :thumbsup:
